_source: Story 020. Addendum 'Affinity (trust), 0-5 per Vessel': XP from time active in combat, kills, perfect parries and dodges; reading that Vessel's lore at a Soul Altar gives +1 level each. Level 1 unlocks the Vessel memory (lore), 2 Sync Guard, 3 Sync Ultimate and +5% stats, 4 Echo Bonus +50%, 5 signature passive. Thresholds (decision D-028): a first pass of Zone 1 (about 40 kills, 5 minutes in combat) brings Caelan to 3; Nyra reaches 2-3 by the end of Zone 2, reading her memory gives the last level.
